title: Fluctuations of the largest eigenvalues of transformed spiked Wigner matrices
summary: Three Major findings: wrong signed sticking lower bound, false E3 edge count, and wrong Appendix D limiting mean. Minor scope/parameter corrections. Fixed-lambda main theorem not disproved.
limitations: Not a complete independent reconstruction of all local-law estimates
General repairs of sticking proof and Appendix D not completed

problems.title: Signed subcritical sticking bound has the wrong direction for admissible negative curvature
problems.location: p7 Proposition4.1; p24 proof first paragraph
problems.check: Exact rank-one reduction; independent N64 illustration
problems.result: H-V=-lambda/sqrt(2N) uu^T; strict decrease almost surely
problems.counterevidence: Two-sided sticking and Tracy-Widom may survive
problems.impact: False proposition and minmax step on main subcritical proof path

correction.statement: Prove required sign-independent sticking or restrict affected hypotheses

recovery_verification.check: Checked admissibility of negative expected curvature, the balanced spike and exact negative rank-one term. The signed proposition/minmax step on the core subcritical proof path fails; the fixed-SNR Tracy-Widom conclusion is not refuted.

problems.title: E3 edge eigenvalue count has exponent2/3, not1/3
problems.check: Integrate semicircle edge density over declared window
problems.result: Count asymptotic N^(2/3); printed crude trace proof after correction gives N^(17/18), too weak for N^(5/6) contradiction
problems.counterevidence: Sharper sum may repair proof; no claim actual trace reaches crude upper bound
problems.impact: Invalid derivation in main sticking proof

recovery_verification.check: Checked the E3 gap-window endpoints and semicircle-edge/rigidity count N^(2/3), not N^(1/3). The displayed crude trace bound becomes N^(17/18), so the stated contradiction fails; no claim that the actual trace attains that bound or that repair is impossible.

problems.title: AppendixD omits normalized-spike centering at fluctuation scale
problems.claim: Equation79 limiting mean and equation75 variance coefficient
assumptions: All relevant bounded-moment, regularity, spike conditions verified
problems.check: Exact reduction, SymPy moments, primary fixed-spike CLT and secular mean-value calculation
problems.result: Actual mean8 variance3/2; literal predicted mean5/4 or20 with missing-prime correction
problems.counterevidence: Separate from fixed-lambda main theorem; ambiguous w4 notation not used
problems.impact: Quantitative extension false in an admissible case

correction.statement: For explicit case center at5/2+8/sqrt(N); general repair must track normalized spike

recovery_verification.check: Checked bounded symmetric noise moments, spike conditions, variance coefficient 16, normalized-spike change, and the fixed-spike primary theorem hypotheses. Theorem1.6 with a smooth squared-resolvent cutoff supplies the derivative step. The explicit limit has mean8 and variance3/2; the literal/prime-corrected paper means5/4 and20 are false. General repair is not claimed.

problems.claim: Mean0 variance1 all finite moments imply spike hypotheses
assumptions: Bounded asymmetric Y=sqrt(2) with probability1/3 and-1/sqrt(2) with probability2/3
problems.check: Third moment and law of large numbers
problems.result: Cubic sum orderN^-1/2 violatesN^-1+epsilon for epsilon<1/2
problems.counterevidence: The theorem explicitly imposes cubic condition; symmetric simulation prior valid

correction.statement: Add zero-third-moment condition and proper normalization

recovery_verification.check: Checked the bounded asymmetric iid prior with nonzero third moment and both normalization conventions. Its cubic sum has order N^(-1/2). The Minor finding concerns the example; the theorem's explicit stronger spike condition remains.
